claimBoundary: This is a fixed estimation-only analysis contract, not a result, power claim, or finding. No LV01 family supported label or 90% power claim may be output for ALA cohorts.

compactSummary.cadence: latest association for every token/receiver taken every 64 training cases and at the final training cutoff, scored with the identical native formula
compactSummary.descriptiveEarlierCadence: Any earlier-cadence readout is separately declared descriptive and labels its staleness.
compactSummary.equalityContract: The final full-content summary and the equal-content unsigned control must predict identically to the corresponding native readout (deterministic sufficiency/integrity check). History supports provenance audit; it is not credited with extra predictive information over its identical sufficient summary.

bootstrap.method: deterministic whole-dyad resampling; resampling seed frozen in the execution manifest
bootstrap.role: sensitivity analysis; never select the more favorable interval

controlContrasts.alpha: 0.05/8 simultaneous one-sided lower bounds over the eight control contrasts (four per cohort: normal-minus-disabled/constant/random/shuffled), dyad-clustered

intervals.primaryCoverage: 97.5% individual intervals for the two primary cohort intervals (Bonferroni 95% joint coverage)

interpretationRules.notEstablished: Failure to meet a rule is 'not established', never proof of no effect.
interpretationRules.positivePreliminary: Positive primary lower bounds in BOTH cohorts AND positive normal-minus-control bounds.
interpretationRules.practicallyPositive: Both primary bounds above 0.02 (inherited prospective reference, not measured utility).

estimation.primaryStatistic: per-dyad equal average over the two receiver roles of mean selected-ordinary Brier minus native Brier on normal-branch test cases; positive favors native
estimation.samplingAssumptions: Dyads are the independent sampling units; across-dyad t-intervals assume approximate normality of dyad means; flag small-N sensitivity explicitly.
estimation.secondaryDescriptives: Other marginal descriptive intervals must be visibly identified as such.
estimation.unit: independently trained dyad; average within receiver role, then equally across roles, then across dyads
estimation.zeroVarianceRule: Flag zero-variance/degenerate intervals; never use zero width to license a positive finding.

fidelity.ledgerMessageContrast: ledger-consistent versus ledger-shuffled target-action probability, descriptive; report whether cohort B agrees, disagrees, or is imprecise; never merge cohorts selectively
fidelity.measure: mean squared distance of native to exact replay probabilities
fidelity.note: A native predictor can occasionally beat exact replay on realized sampled Brier by chance; it cannot add information beyond complete policy state in expectation.

independentReduction.environment: uv-managed statistics environment with pinned requirements.txt; separate self-contained paper-repo environment for paper figures
forbidden: importing the TypeScript scorer or its result fields
independentReduction.implementation: independent Python/scipy reduction from canonical per-case/per-dyad inputs

invaliditySensitivity: Report valid-only inference plus descriptive worst-admissible-value bounds across every attempted dyad; do not claim missingness is ignorable.

nativePredictor.informationNote: The native readout may contain learner information absent from ordinary records; state this information advantage in every comparison.
nativePredictor.selection: Latest verified ledger sequence before cutoff for receiver and token
nativePredictor.source: authenticated training-only hypothesis.created, hypothesis.revised, or hypothesis.contradicted ledger event
nativePredictor.value: associationOverTypeCodes normalized over the current four candidates after adding 1e-12 to each nonnegative weight

ordinaryRecordWindow.deliveryFactScope: Delivery/action facts observed via intention.recorded + outcome agreement are the ordinary record's own fields, not forbidden ledger content.
ordinaryRecordWindow.emptyFoldRule: Empty folds fail closed; no silent drop.
ordinaryRecordWindow.majorityReconciliation: The validation-majority baseline follows the same rule: fit and selection on declared folds, final refit on all permitted training plus validation observations.
ordinaryRecordWindow.refit: chosen model refits using training, validation-fit and validation-selection records before test prediction; prove the committed fit equals that refit
ordinaryRecordWindow.selection: lowest realized multiclass Brier on validation-selection; tie tolerance 1e-12 and predictor list order; never select on test data; never omit softmax for convenience

overheadBenchmark.counts: explicit operation/byte counts; first 1000 canonical training events from the first eligible A dyad in manifest order
forbidden: claiming a new trained-agent causal effect
overheadBenchmark.keys: fresh temporary outputs and non-study in-memory signing keys; sealed originals preserved
overheadBenchmark.measure: limited record/query/audit overhead on the measured host; report raw repeats, median, range
overheadBenchmark.paths: one warmup and three measured replays through ordinary append-only and authenticated recording paths with identical numerical content and order; simulated anchoring only
overheadBenchmark.trackedIn: this protocol (binding); run at most three timed whole-bundle verifications of that dyad and 500 fixed native-query versus exact-policy-forward calls

predictors.fit: Laplace-smoothed actual action positions; fit and selection use their declared folds and final refit uses all permitted training plus validation observations
Laplace-smoothed actual action positions conditional on delivered token only
Laplace-smoothed token/type counts using ordinary records

predictors.features: bias, token one-hot, candidate type one-hot, position one-hot, token/type interaction
predictors.fit: 2000 full-batch gradient steps, learning rate 0.05, L2 penalty 0.01 excluding bias, zero initialization
latest authenticated receiver token association strictly before training cutoff, per the nativePredictor block
frozen recurrent receiver forward pass with checkpoint hidden state, delivered token, candidate observation and temperature 1; no state advance
identical numerical payload and update schedule as the native ledger; predictions must match native exactly, isolating authentication overhead and detection

same 32-by-16 association representation at fixed training checkpoints every 64 episodes and at the final cutoff, using the same frozen projection function for both roles; report actual bytes and queries

score.expectedExcessReplayFormula: sum over ordered candidates of (nativeProbability - exactReplayProbability)^2
score.formula: sum over ordered candidates of (probability - one-hot actual action)^2
score.name: multiclass-brier/v1
